name: Salty Scorpid Venom
summary: Across Thousand Needles, Salty Scorpid Venom draws gnomes into a dangerous race for speed. Scorpids on the Shimmering Flats carry the desert floor's mineral salts in their venom, and gnomish racers seek it for fuel.

sections.title: A Volatile Combustion Agent
sections.body: Scorpids on the mineral-rich Shimmering Flats carry salt in their venom. Scorpid Reavers and Scorpid Terrors have absorbed those local salts over generations. Fizzle Brassbolts and other gnomish tinkers prize the caustic venom as a possible additive for high-combustion engine fuel, not for antidotes or ordinary poisons.

sections.title: Fueling the Raceway Rivalry
sections.body: At the Mirage Raceway, gnomes and goblins test ever more dangerous materials in their rocket cars. Fizzle Brassbolts believes boiling down the salted venom, treating it with specialized catalysts, and mixing it into propellant tanks will give his car the fierce heat it needs to outrun goblin racers on the salt pans.

faq.q: What creatures produce Salty Scorpid Venom?
faq.answer: Scorpid Reavers and Scorpid Terrors on the Thousand Needles salt flats produce Salty Scorpid Venom.

faq.q: Why is the venom so salty?
faq.answer: The scorpids live on the mineral-crusted ground of the Shimmering Flats. Their bodies absorb the dried lakebed's dense salts, giving their venom a high saline concentration.

faq.q: Who wants this venom and why?
faq.answer: Fizzle Brassbolts, a gnome engineer at the Mirage Raceway, seeks the venom for an experimental fuel mixture. He believes it will burn hot enough to propel his rocket car to victory.

angles.text: As a gnome, you know the risks of turning lethal desert venom into rocket fuel with nega-catalysts, all to shave seconds off a lap.
As an engineer, you see inventors on the Shimmering Flats look beyond petroleum and coal. They test organic toxins as volatile accelerants.
